about_the_game:
Welcome to the Apex Automata Demo!

In the starless void of the future, a mechanical rebellion threatens humanity. Join the Android Resistance and fight for freedom!

This exclusive demo lets you experience the beginning of an epic journey against rogue machines in a fast-paced top-down shooter. Step into the role of cybernetic heroes and prepare to face relentless waves of enemies!

What’s included in the demo:

  • 2 playable characters: Try out different combat styles with Alpha-101, the seasoned Vanguard, and Sara-977, the optimistic android ready for battle.

  • 1 complete level: Engage in intense action across a fully playable stage packed with enemies and challenges.

  • 2 permanent upgrades: Enhance your abilities and increase your survival chances with upgrades that persist between runs.

Master the action, test your strategy, and witness the beginning of a galactic uprising. The future starts now — with you!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E6320 (2*1866) or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce 650 or equivalent
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i3-2100 / AMD A8-5600k
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 630 / Radeon HD 6570
  • Storage: 1 MB available space
  • Sound Card: 1

short_description: Get ready for an epic showdown against rebel machines in Android Resistance, a frenetic top-down shooter that challenges your skills and strategy. Take on the role of Adrian-317, the wise Vanguard, and assemble a diverse team of androids, each with their unique abilities.
